title: Semantic Workbench mapping extension (application schema, not part of Apache Ossie)
description: Content of the JSON string in the root custom_extensions entry with vendor_name SEMANTIC_WORKBENCH of a standalone Ossie mapping document (or of the embedded semantic_model root in a consolidated file). Binds KPIs (metrics of the referenced semantic model) to ontology concepts. Written with one binding per line, sorted by metric name. Draft; the pinned copy will live in schemas/semantic-workbench-mapping-v1.json.

metric.description: Name of a metric in the semantic model named by semantic_model_ref

measures.description: Concept name, IRI or declared QName of the ontology concept the KPI measures

of.description: Concept the KPI is about (for example the entity it is computed per)
